description: Every finite partial isomorphism in the strict-order language between a linear order \(M\) and a nonempty dense linear order without endpoints \(N\) extends to include any prescribed element of \(M\) in its domain.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BackAndForth.strict_forth.{w, w'} {A : Type w} {B : Type w'} [LinearOrder A]
  [LinearOrder B] [DenselyOrdered B] [NoMinOrder B] [NoMaxOrder B] [Nonempty B]
  (p :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BackAndForth.FinitePartialIso
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSyntax.binaryRelLanguage A B)
  (a : A) : ∃ q, p ≤ q ∧ a ∈ q.dom
